plainText:
James Weaver Clark is a voice actor for the English dub of .

==Biography==
Clark is an American voice actor. He joined during , voicing several Pokémon in the Hoopa's Surprise Ring Adventures shorts before joining the during as Mad Magmar. In 2017, he married fellow voice actor Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld, who also works on Pokémon the Series.
